summary: Southern California Gas Company, an indirect subsidiary of Sempra, filed an 8-K reporting an underwriting agreement dated August 17, 2026 to issue and sell $500 million of 5.500% First Mortgage Bonds, Series GGG, due 2036, at a public offering price of 99.405%. The offering is a routine registered debt issuance under an existing shelf registration statement. Underwriters are Barclays, Credit Agricole, MUFG and TD Securities. This is an ordinary shelf takedown, not a special situation; no restructuring, acquisition or strategic event is involved.
